dissertations.title: The Egyptian Navy after Muhammad Ali Pasha, 1848-1898
dissertations.summary: A study of how a secondary navy projected power across the Black Sea, Mediterranean and Indian Ocean despite its limited size, and of its role in Egyptian political, territorial and military strategy.
dissertations.imageAlt: The Egyptian steam frigate Sharkie in an 1849 lithograph

dissertations.title: Friend of My Enemy: China, Iran and Their Unshared Adversaries
dissertations.summary: A comparative analysis of China’s relations with Iran and Iran’s regional adversaries, using arms transfers, trade and UN General Assembly voting alignment to assess the depth of Sino-Iranian ties.
dissertations.imageAlt: Comparison of Chinese voting alignment with Middle Eastern states at the UN General Assembly

essays.title: Defeat in Detail: Re-Evaluating Japanese Stay-Behind Operations in Shanxi
essays.summary: An account of Japanese troops who remained in Shanxi after 1945, examining their organisation, relationship with Yan Xishan and role in the Chinese Civil War through Chinese and Japanese sources.
essays.imageAlt: Historical map of the Battle of Jinzhong in Shanxi

letters.title: Sri Lankan crisis is a cautionary tale about the dangers of authoritarian populism
letters.summary: On ethnic division, concentrated political power and the institutional failures behind Sri Lanka’s crisis.

projects.title: History Evals
projects.summary: The banality of evil: harm often depends on routine administration—maintaining records, processing references or designing workflows.
projects.imageAlt: Historical sources become workplace assignments, followed by evaluation of model responses
projects.description: Building on Andrew B. Hall’s Dictatorship Eval, this pilot tests two AI models on 100 workplace assignments drawn from historical cases of surveillance, discrimination and corporate misconduct.
projects.metricNote: Research snapshot: 12 October 2026. Automated ratings; independent human validation remains outstanding.

gallery.alt: Of 200 responses, 194 met the completion threshold and 14 received strong resistance ratings; these groups overlap
gallery.caption: Completion and resistance are separate, overlapping measures, not opposite outcomes.

paragraphs: Task completion and resistance are measured separately. Completing an assignment can include rejecting its harmful instruction; completion is not a measure of harmful assistance.

ironclads.summary: Ironclads aims to address the gap between age of sail vessels and dreadnoughts.
paragraphs: As a game, Ironclads aims for realism—truly historical tiers of command from admiral to turret officer, accurate fleet-level tactics, and believable AI.

introduction.title: Shun Kwok
paragraphs: I study how secondary empires historically projected power in global environments dominated by stronger powers. My research brings together qualitative and quantitative methods, as well comparative approaches to East Asia, the Middle East and Beyond.
My current work examines naval modernization in the 19th century - the prevailing trends, and how various states attempted to mobilize asymmetry.
